**Why it matters:** Targeting pathways that enhance protein synthesis or mitigate the downstream effects of impaired translation could offer therapeutic strategies for both Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2D and Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease recessive intermediate B.
